provenance.install: cargo install vaultlint, version 0.1.1, built and run inside a container
provenance.install_documented_at: the crate's own page and repository README
provenance.note: Released July 2026; 52 crates.io downloads in its entire history. A weak popularity signal recorded in docs/SCANNERS.md, not a quality judgement.

run.reason: The 2026-08-31 invocation was not written into any artefact in this repository, and the tool was not re-run on 2026-09-01. The VPS image vaultlint-runner:local still exists, so this is recoverable by whoever runs it next; it is recorded as unknown rather than reconstructed from memory.
run.invocation_evidence: What is known: vaultlint 0.1.1 with its `scan` subcommand, in a container, on 2026-08-31. The corpus-2 run has a per-case log (raw/c2-vaultlint-complete.json.log) proving 8 cases were analysed, and the corpus-1 run has none.

evidence.reason: the corpus-2 row has a per-case run log and is scored from it; how that log's ok/unavailable decision was made is not recorded, so the classifier itself cannot be checked. The corpus-1 row has no log at all.

findings.message: Account data is deserialised without an owner check

positive_control.sample_source: the shape of raw/vaultlint.json, with one finding substituted for the fix site of the synthetic case

measurements.note: 2 / 11 nominal and real, from 4 findings across 35 files. No per-run log.

measurements.envelope_note: This file is NOT in vaultlint's own envelope. It was hand-converted into the flat sol-audit shape in 2026-08-31 by a script that was never committed, which is why the declared envelope differs from the tool's. The conversion is unreproducible and that is a defect, not a design choice; it stays declared as sol-audit because that is what the committed bytes are, and pretending otherwise would silently change a published number.
measurements.note: Covers 8 of the 17 valid cases, so run_all reports it `partial` with 8 not-run and a scoreable denominator of 1. It is the row the B7 handover asks to be re-run first.
